lastCompletedStory.title: Add CAM_TMUX_SOCKET + tmuxArgs() and thread -L cam through src/tmux/session.ts

nextStoryContext: US-001 is the foundation story. CAM_TMUX_SOCKET and tmuxArgs() are now exported from src/tmux/session.ts. All tmux calls in session.ts now use -L cam prefix. The next stories (US-002 through US-008) need to thread -L cam through the remaining call sites: src/commands/run.ts (US-002), src/commands/claude.ts (US-003), src/retry/tmux.ts (US-004), src/commands/retry-monitor.ts (US-005), etc. Pattern: fake spawn handlers in tests should route by subcommand using `const subcommand = args[0] === '-L' ? args[2] : args[0]`; assertions check args[0]==='-L', args[1]==='cam', args[2]===subcommand.

officialDocsValidated.summary: -L is a global option preceding the subcommand; `tmux -L cam new-session` is confirmed correct. Implementation matches.
